finalText:
Dedup added (`src/router.js:32`), backed by a `lastSentAt` map now returned from `createState()`.

Replay confirms it catches exactly the planted flaps: 99 dropped, matching the ~every-ninth repeat `events.js` injects two minutes after its predecessor. All four priorities lost roughly a ninth of their volume, and no non-repeat traffic was affected.

Three details in how I built it:

- The dedup check runs before quiet hours, so a quiet-hour repeat is dropped rather than queued — it's the same notification either way.
- Only a delivery updates the timestamp. A dropped repeat does not extend the window, so the 5 minutes always runs from the last thing actually sent.
- I read "in the last 5 minutes" as strictly under 5 minutes, so a repeat landing exactly 5 minutes later goes through. Change `<` to `<=` in `route()` if you want that one suppressed too.
